documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for To Consider Un-Audited Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results Of The Company For The Quarter And Half Year Ended 30Th September, 2026.

Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: In Q1 FY27, Menon Bearings Limited achieved its highest-ever quarterly sales, EBITDA, profit before tax, and PAT in the history of the company. Consolidated sales grew 36.57% year-on-year to INR 91.79 crores, driven by robust demand across business segments and operational efficiencies. Management expressed confidence in sustaining growth momentum, backed by strong OEM relationships, potential new business from recent visits to the US and Canada, and expansion into railway and EV components. Planned capacity expansions across bi-metal and aluminium divisions are expected to be funded entirely through internal accruals. Menon Bearings reported its highest-ever quarterly consolidated revenue of Rs 94.04 crore, EBITDA of Rs 22.38 crore, and Net Profit of Rs 14.11 crore for Q1 FY27, driven by strong performance across its bimetal, alkop, and braking systems segments.

guidance.claim: Management expects additional business potential of around INR 65 crores to INR 75 crores over the current and next financial year.
guidance.quote: The total potential of additional business for the current and next financial year is expected to be around INR65 crores to INR75 crores, subject to good monsoon and geopolitical situation doesn't worsen further.

guidance.claim: The company is targeting INR 100 crores in revenue for Alkop this year and around INR 125 crores next year.
guidance.quote: For this year, we are targeting Alkop for INR100 crores, next year around INR125 crores.

guidance.claim: Management expects exports to reach up to 37% of total revenue by next year.
guidance.quote: As we expect that by next year, the export may go up to 37% after total revenue.

guidance.claim: Management stated that INR 360 crores is a conservative revenue guidance for the current year.
guidance.quote: So, INR360 crores, I would say is a conservative figure and we will stick to that.

guidance.claim: The company is targeting an overall turnover growth rate of 25% year-on-year for the next few years.
guidance.quote: And again, we will be sustaining this because of increase in the overall turnover which we are targeting at a rate of 25% year-on-year for next few years.

guidance.claim: Management stated an optimistic target to reach INR 500 crores by 2028.
guidance.quote: And we will take all-out efforts to see how we can reach INR500 crores by '28.

guidance.claim: The company expects to maintain EBITDA margins between 20% and 22% during the next two years.
guidance.quote: I again assure you that considering the present situation going forward, we will be able to maintain EBITDA more than 20% and it should be about between 20% to 22% during next two years.

guidance.claim: Management estimated revenues for FY27 to be more than INR 360 crores.
guidance.quote: Precisely, what we have estimated is more than INR 360 crores.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the underlying demand outlook for the automotive and engineering sectors remains encouraging despite global uncertainties.
demand_outlook.quote: While the global business environment continues to present certain uncertainties, the underlying demand outlook for the automotive and engineering sector remains encouraging.

demand_outlook.claim: Tractor demand may be affected temporarily by monsoon conditions, but government spending on public projects and the 15-year vehicle scrapping policy are supporting steady demand.
demand_outlook.quote: You see, considering the monsoon position that may -- in tractor segment affect today to some extent, not larger, because in some parts there is a drought-like situation, but it is expected to improve within this month or next month.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is gaining business entries for Menon Alkop driven by China Plus One policies and brand recognition in North America.
demand_outlook.quote: So these customers, because of China Plus One policy, and Menon Bearing brand name for the last 20 years, we have Menon Alkop also gotten the entry.

demand_outlook.claim: The company continues to operate within its primary segment of auto components where sustained demand is being observed.
demand_outlook.quote: We continue to operate within our primary segment of auto components where we are seeing sustained demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Exports to the USA market have gone up by almost 50% over the last year.
demand_outlook.quote: So far as USA market is concerned, our exports have gone up by almost 50% over last year so far as USA market is concerned and there is a lot of opportunities we are looking for.

demand_outlook.claim: European countries are looking to divert their volumes and businesses from China to India and have been floating inquiries.
demand_outlook.quote: Since European countries are looking to divert their volumes and businesses from China to India and they are tapping our doors and we'll be very happy to see that they come into our fold from the next year.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is investing INR 9 crores to INR 10 crores this financial year to increase capacity by 25% to 30%.
capex_expansion.quote: If you go through the presentation, Rucheeta, you will come to know that we are investing about INR9 crores to INR10 crores of rupees for this year, this financial year for increasing the capacity and which is expected to increase the capacity by almost 25% to 30%, which may yield the total revenue of more than INR25 crores, which can generate revenue of INR25 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans capital expenditure of around INR 4 crores for the Alkop division alone in the current financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: And we are having the CapEx of around INR4 crores of for this year in Alkop alone.

capex_expansion.claim: Additional future CapEx is expected to yield an asset turnover of approximately 2.5 times.
capex_expansion.quote: See, whatever future CapEx that we are going to do, the additional CapEx will have asset turn of around 2.5.

capex_expansion.claim: Planned capex for the Alkop division is INR 7 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: And for Alkop, it is INR7 crores and brakes, it is INR3 crores.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for Q1 FY27 reached over 21% in bi-metal, almost 21% in Alkop, and 25% in the brakes segment.
margins_costs.quote: So, for the bi-metal is concerned the margin, so, EBITDA margins are around 21% plus. Then Alkop, it is almost 21%. And now, for this quarter, in brakes, we have achieved 25%.

margins_costs.claim: The company expects to sustain consolidated EBITDA margins around 20% to 21% over time.
margins_costs.quote: But overall, on a consolidated basis, if you see, we will sustainaround 20% to 21% of margins over a period of time.

margins_costs.claim: Prices of consumable items like carbide tools have surged by 300%.
margins_costs.quote: Consumables, for example, carbide tools for all manufacturers, all automobile carbide tools are required.Those carbide tools price are increased by 300%.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material costs increased by about 20% to 25%, while average aluminium prices ranged from INR 340 to INR 370.
margins_costs.quote: You see, even after increasing the raw material prices by about 20%, 25%, still, not only we have sustained, but our margins have increased further.

margins_costs.claim: Energy-efficient LED motors, lighting, and electric holding boilers with pre-heat chambers save 1,800-2,000 kWh/year each.
Raw material price burdens were successfully passed on to customers to a large extent.
margins_costs.quote: so far as material consumption is here raw material prices are going up, we were successful in passing on that burden of raw material to the customers to the larger extent.

margins_costs.claim: Export margins are always better than aftermarket or OEM.
margins_costs.quote: That is for exports, where margins are always better than aftermarket or OEM.

orders_capacity.claim: The bi-metal division alone has peak revenue potential exceeding INR 400 crores with existing infrastructure.
orders_capacity.quote: Peak revenue from this, it can be aboveINR400 crores.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has an active RFQ pipeline of around INR 75 crores combined for Alkop and Bi-metal divisions.
orders_capacity.quote: So, put together, Alkop, that is Aluminium and Bi-metal put together, the list of such RFQ list is about INR75 crores of rupees apart from the potential business that we may get through our visits to Canada and USA, that is different.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has an installed capacity of 30 lakh units/annum for brake lines.
orders_capacity.quote: Installed capacity 30 lakh units/annum for Brake Lines

orders_capacity.claim: The new development parts pipeline includes 51 new parts representing a business value of almost INR 30 crores within this year and next year.
orders_capacity.quote: Our new development parts pipeline is robust with 51 new parts across major customers like John Deere for India domestic and exports as well. Eaton, Taco Prestolite and Mayekawa representing a business value of almost INR 30 crores within this year and next year.

orders_capacity.claim: The bi-metal division has a robust pipeline of more than INR 50 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: With this, apart from this, in Bi-Metal division also, we are having a robust pipeline of more than INR 50 crores.

orders_capacity.claim: Aluminium division capacity is currently 1,500 tonnes per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Currently we are operating at 1,500 tonne.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization in Alkop is currently 65% and likely to go up to 90% by the end of the year.
orders_capacity.quote: Utilization as of now is 65% and it is likely to go up to 90% by the end of this year so that we will have to engage another furnace next year.

capital_allocation.claim: Planned capital expenditure for the bi-metal and Alkop divisions will be funded completely through internal accruals without taking fresh debt.
capital_allocation.quote: You see, so far as whatever we are considering so far as bi-metal and Alkop is concerned, it will be through internal accruals only, no fresh loan will be taken.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board declared a dividend of Rs 2 per share having face value of Re 1 each.
capital_allocation.quote: Note: The Board has declared Dividend of Rs. 2 per share having face value of Re. 1 each

capital_allocation.claim: Most of the planned capex will be financed with internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: and whatever capex is that we are going to do that most of it will be financed with internal accruals.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faces cost pressures from rising cargo ship transportation, domestic freight, and sharp increases in consumable prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: Basic ship cargo transportation has increased significantly. Indian transport has increased. Like I told you, consumable, the oil, gas, compressors, carbide tools, for example, that has increased by 300%.

risks_headwinds.claim: Forward-looking statements are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties, and assumptions that are difficult to predict.
risks_headwinds.quote: Such forward-looking statements are not guarantees of future performance and are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties and assumptions that are difficult to predict.

risks_headwinds.claim: The new labour code has been introduced by the government with regulations issued in April 2025.
risks_headwinds.quote: Now, as a legal compliance, so the new labour code has been introduced by the government and the regulations have been issued in the month of April '25.

risks_headwinds.claim: Export shipments to African countries through Dubai were halted for the last three months, affecting business to the extent of almost INR 2 crores.
risks_headwinds.quote: For last three months, we have -- that export is halted. That has affected to the extent of almost INR2 crores of business that we have lost during last three months.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets revenue of INR 100 crores for Alkop this year and around INR 125 crores for next year.
management_commitments.quote: For this year, we are targeting Alkop for INR100 crores, next year around INR125 crores.

management_commitments.claim: The company commits to funding bi-metal and Alkop capacity investments solely through internal accruals without taking new loans.
management_commitments.quote: You see, so far as whatever we are considering so far as bi-metal and Alkop is concerned, it will be through internal accruals only, no fresh loan will be taken.

management_commitments.claim: The company will complete the raw material price pass-on for the remaining one or two customers during the current quarter.
management_commitments.quote: Maybe one or two customers are left and that will be completed during this quarter also.

management_commitments.claim: The testing dynamometer for the braking division will be received by the end of August.
management_commitments.quote: That is under production and we will be receiving it by the end of August and thereafter we will take up the business not only of railways but OEMs business also will be in our fold, I am sure.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets to reach an overall asset turnover of 2 by 2028.
management_commitments.quote: By '28, we should be reaching that 100%.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
